title: huperzia × bartleyi

This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including the ability to improve cognitive function and reduce the risk of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. The therapeutic actions of Huperzia × bartleyi are attributed to its ability to act as a nootropic agent, enhancing memory and learning capabilities, as well as its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include huperzine A, a potent inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase, which is an enzyme that breaks down acetylcholine, a neurotransmitter involved in memory and cognitive function.
